LanguageData.Gun_Mini-UZI_RWP.label: Mini-UZI
LanguageData.Gun_Mini-UZI_RWP.description: A compact submachine gun, the Mini-Uzi offers rapid-fire capability and high mobility. It's perfect for close-quarters combat, delivering a quick barrage of bullets. Though lacking long-range accuracy, its lightweight design and rate of fire make it ideal for hit-and-run tactics. Be mindful of its high ammo consumption in prolonged engagements.
